evidence.title: Quantum Startup Oratomic Now Worth $5.4 Billion After Series-B Funding

occurrences.checkable_against: Index Ventures investment records and Martin Mignot public statements
occurrences.quote_span: “We had never made an investment in quantum, and to be honest, a lot of the stuff we saw felt pretty sci-fi and really far from ever going commercial,” he said.
occurrences.speaker: Martin Mignot
occurrences.subject: Oratomic

occurrences.checkable_against: Oratomic product-development roadmap and public statements

occurrences.checkable_against: Oratomic Series B financing announcement and investment records
occurrences.quote_span: Quantum computing startup Oratomic raised $475 million, just three months after its Series A, the latest sign of growing investor enthusiasm in the nascent technology.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Oratomic

occurrences.checkable_against: Oratomic corporate materials and product-development records
occurrences.quote_span: The Pasadena, Calif., company is focused on building a large-scale, fault-tolerant, error-corrected quantum computer it says will deliver on the commercial promises of quantum computing.
occurrences.speaker: Oratomic
occurrences.subject: Oratomic

occurrences.checkable_against: Oratomic corporate leadership records
occurrences.quote_span: Oratomic CEO and co-founder, Dolev Bluvstein said the company’s approach better positions it to focus on the right problems.
occurrences.speaker: Dolev Bluvstein
occurrences.subject: Oratomic

occurrences.checkable_against: Oratomic corporate formation records
occurrences.quote_span: Oratomic, founded in 2025, joins a growing class of multibillion-dollar quantum startups building technology that promises to solve problems far beyond the capabilities of today’s best supercomputers, with applications across pharmaceuticals, materials science and other industries.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Oratomic
